test_cmd_mcp_list: test the cmd_mcp_list function that lists configured MCP servers and their status
test_cmd_mcp_add: test the cmd_mcp_add function that adds HTTP or stdio MCP servers with tool selection
test_cmd_mcp_remove: test the cmd_mcp_remove function that removes an MCP server and cleans OAuth tokens
test_cmd_mcp_test: test the cmd_mcp_test function that probes an MCP server and reports discovered tools
test_cmd_mcp_login: test the cmd_mcp_login function that forces re-authentication for OAuth-enabled servers
test_env_var_interpolation: test the _interpolate_env_vars function that substitutes environment variables in strings, dicts, and lists
test_mcp_command_dispatcher: test the mcp_command dispatcher that routes to subcommands or shows help when no action is specified
test_preset_server_add: test adding an MCP server using a preset that fills in command and args from _MCP_PRESETS
test_remove_evicts_oauth_cache: test that cmd_mcp_remove evicts the MCPOAuthManager in-memory provider cache
